recommended_fix.summary: De-duplicate `user_dim` and restore its key uniqueness — the duplicate keys are fanning out every downstream join. Owner: identity-team@example.com.
recommended_fix.action:
-- confirm the fanout before fixing it
SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS copies
FROM user_dim
GROUP BY user_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY copies DESC;
recommended_fix.action_note: Add a uniqueness assertion on this key so a duplicate load fails at the source instead of silently inflating downstream metrics.
